mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_symbol SET layer = NULL, layer_confidence = NULL WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND layer IS NOT NULL
UPDATE analysis_method SET proxy_related = FALSE WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND proxy_related
mapper.insert:
WITH rule(annotation_name, http_method, method_attribute) AS ( VALUES (#{m.annotation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}::text, #{m.httpMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR}::text, #{m.methodAttribute, jdbcType=VARCHAR}::text) ), mapping AS ( SELECT a.target_kind, a.target_id, a.annotation_name, a.file_id, a.line_start, a.attributes_json , COALESCE(a.attributes_json->#{key}::text) AS paths FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND (a.annotation_name IN (SELECT annotation_name FROM rule)
OR (a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.annotation_name IN #{name}) ) ) INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, http_method, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'HTTP', hm.name , CASE WHEN joined.path = '/' THEN '/' ELSE regexp_replace(joined.path, '/$', '') END , m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('annotation', mm.annotation_name) , mm.file_id, mm.line_start FROM mapping mm JOIN rule rl ON rl.annotation_name = mm.annotation_name JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = mm.target_id LEFT JOIN mapping cm ON cm.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND cm.target_id = m.owner_symbol_id AND cm.annotation_name IN
#{name}
(NULL)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL AS cp(path) CROSS JOIN LATERAL AS mp(path) CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rl.http_method AS name WHERE rl.http_method IS NOT NULL UNION ALL -- @RequestMapping(method = RequestMethod.GET) 의 GET. 적지 않았으면 모든 메소드를 받는다(ALL). SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(e.text, '^.*\.', ''), ''), 'ALL') FROM AS e(text) WHERE rl.http_method IS NULL ) hm -- 클래스 주소가 /* 로 끝나면 그 /* 를 떼고 잇는다. Spring 이 주소를 합치는 규칙과 같다. -- @RequestMapping("/sample/user/*") + @RequestMapping("/listUser.do") → /sample/user/listUser.do (/sample/user/*/listUser.do 가 아니다) -- /** 로 끝나면 Spring 도 그대로 잇는다(/a/** + /b → /a/**/b). CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT regexp_replace('/' || regexp_replace(cp.path, '/\*$', '') || '/' || mp.path, '/+', '/', 'g') AS path) joined WHERE mm.target_kind = 'METHOD'
mapper.select: SELECT a.target_kind AS "targetKind" , a.target_id AS "targetId" , a.annotation_name AS "annotationName" , a.attributes_json::text AS "attributesJson" , a.file_id AS "fileId" , a.line_start AS "lineStart" , m.owner_symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId" , m.name AS "methodName" , m.param_count AS "paramCount" FROM analysis_annotation a LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND m.revision_id = a.revision_id AND m.method_id = a.target_id WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind IN ('TYPE', 'METHOD') AND a.annotation_name IN #{n} ORDER BY a.annotation_id

SELECT from_id AS "fromId", to_id AS "toId", relation_type AS "relationType" FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS') AND from_kind = 'TYPE' AND to_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relation_id

SELECT method_id AS "methodId", owner_symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId", name AS "name", param_count AS "paramCount" FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT is_static AND NOT is_constructor AND owner_symbol_id IN #{id} ORDER BY method_id

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, #{endpointType} , COALESCE(a.attributes_json->>#{key}::text) NULL
, m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('annotation', a.annotation_name) || a.attributes_json , a.file_id, a.line_start FROM analysis_annotation a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = a.revision_id AND m.method_id = a.target_id WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND a.annotation_name IN #{name}

INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, to_external , confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.field_id) #{revisionId}, 'TYPE', f.owner_symbol_id, 'INJECTS', r.to_kind, r.to_id, r.to_external , r.confidence, r.resolution_status , jsonb_build_object('field', f.name, 'annotation', a.annotation_name) , f.file_id, f.line_start FROM analysis_annotation a JOIN analysis_field f ON f.revision_id = a.revision_id AND f.field_id = a.target_id JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = a.revision_id AND r.from_id = f.field_id AND r.relation_type = 'USES_TYPE' WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = 'FIELD' AND a.annotation_name IN #{name} ORDER BY f.field_id, r.relation_id
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_method m SET proxy_related = TRUE WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT m.is_constructor AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = m.revision_id AND a.annotation_name IN #{name} AND ((a.target_kind = 'METHOD' AND a.target_id = m.method_id) OR (a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.target_id = m.owner_symbol_id)))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, http_method, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'SERVLET' , CASE m.name WHEN 'service' THEN 'ALL' ELSE upper(substring(m.name FROM 3)) END , url.path, m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('annotation', 'WebServlet') , a.file_id, m.line_start FROM analysis_annotation a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = a.revision_id AND m.owner_symbol_id = a.target_id AND m.name IN ('doGet', 'doPost', 'doPut', 'doDelete', 'doHead', 'doOptions', 'service') CROSS JOIN LATERAL AS url(path) WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.annotation_name = 'WebServlet'
mapper.select: SELECT method_id AS "methodId", name AS "name", line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId} AND name IN ('doGet', 'doPost', 'doPut', 'doDelete', 'doHead', 'doOptions', 'service') AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY line_start
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, http_method, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{endpointType}, #{httpMethod}, #{path}, #{symbolId}, #{methodId} , CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_resource (revision_id, resource_type, name, location, value, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{resourceType}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{location, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{value, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, symbol_id, method_id, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'MAIN', m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id, m.file_id, m.line_start FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.name = 'main' AND m.is_static AND m.visibility = 'public' AND m.signature IN ('main(String[])', 'main(String...)', 'main(java.lang.String[])', 'main(java.lang.String...)')

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, path, file_id, line_start) SELECT #{revisionId}, 'JSP' , '/' || regexp_replace(f.path, '^(.*/)?(webapp|WebContent|WebRoot)/', '') , f.file_id, 1 FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.language = 'JSP' AND f.path !~ '(^|/)WEB-INF/'
mapper.select: SELECT value AS "urlPattern", properties_json->>'class' AS "servletClass" FROM analysis_resource WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND resource_type = 'SERVLET_MAPPING' ORDER BY resource_id
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_symbol s SET layer = 'VIEW', layer_confidence = 'HIGH' FROM analysis_file f WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_id = s.file_id AND f.language = 'JSP'

UPDATE analysis_endpoint e SET symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id, method_id = m.method_id FROM analysis_method m WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND e.endpoint_type = 'JSP' AND m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.file_id = e.file_id AND m.name = '_jspService'
mapper.insert:
WITH INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT r.revision_id, 'METHOD', r.from_id, 'RENDERS', 'FILE', 'F' || MIN(f.file_id), 'HIGH', 'RESOLVED' , jsonb_build_object('view', v.name), r.file_id, r.line_start FROM analysis_reference r JOIN analysis_method caller ON caller.revision_id = r.revision_id AND caller.method_id = r.from_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS text) arg CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT regexp_replace(trim(both '"' from arg.text), '^/+', '') AS name) v JOIN analysis_file f ON f.revision_id = r.revision_id AND f.language = 'JSP' AND (f.path = #{prefix} || v.name || #{suffix} OR right(f.path, length(#{prefix} || v.name || #{suffix}) + 1) = '/' || #{prefix} || v.name || #{suffix}) WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_kind = 'METHOD'
AND arg.text IS NOT NULL AND arg.text ~ '^"[^"]+"$' AND trim(both '"' from arg.text) !~ #{exclude} -- 규칙 여럿이 같은 호출에 맞으면 한 번만 잇는다. AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation x WHERE x.revision_id = r.revision_id AND x.relation_type = 'RENDERS' AND x.from_id = r.from_id AND x.file_id = r.file_id AND x.line_start = r.line_start AND x.properties_json->>'view' = v.name) GROUP BY r.revision_id, r.reference_id, r.from_id, v.name, r.file_id, r.line_start HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT path AS "path", method_id AS "methodId" FROM analysis_endpoint WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND endpoint_type IN ('HTTP', 'SERVLET') AND method_id IS NOT NULL AND path IS NOT NULL
SELECT file_id FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = 'JSP' AND (path = #{path} OR right(path, length(#{path}) + 1) = '/' || #{path}) LIMIT 2

SELECT file_id AS "fileId", path AS "path", encoding AS "encoding" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND file_type = 'SCRIPT' AND (path = #{path} OR right(path, length(#{path}) + 1) = '/' || #{path}) ORDER BY file_id LIMIT 2
SELECT DISTINCT file_id FROM analysis_resource WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND resource_type = 'SCREEN_NAME' AND file_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT m.name AS "name", m.method_id AS "methodId", s.fqn AS "ownerFqn" FROM analysis_method m LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.name IN #{name} AND NOT m.is_synthetic AND NOT m.is_constructor ORDER BY m.name, m.method_id
SELECT file_id FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND file_type IN #{fileType} AND (path = #{path} OR right(path, length(#{path}) + 1) = '/' || #{path}) LIMIT 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT m.revision_id, 'TRANSACTION' , substr(m.name, length(#{prefix}) + 1, length(m.name) - length(#{prefix}) - length(#{suffix})) , m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , jsonb_build_object('function', #{function}::text, 'rule', #{template}::text) , m.file_id, m.line_start FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT m.is_synthetic AND NOT m.is_constructor AND NOT m.is_static AND upper(COALESCE(m.visibility, '')) = 'PUBLIC' AND length(m.name) > length(#{prefix}) + length(#{suffix}) AND left(m.name, length(#{prefix})) = #{prefix} AND right(m.name, length(#{suffix})) = #{suffix} -- 규칙 여럿이 같은 틀(perform{id})을 쓰면 같은 메소드가 또 맞는다. 진입점은 메소드마다 하나만 둔다. AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = m.revision_id AND e.endpoint_type = 'TRANSACTION' AND e.method_id = m.method_id) ORDER BY m.method_id

INSERT INTO analysis_endpoint (revision_id, endpoint_type, path, symbol_id, method_id, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT m.revision_id, 'TRANSACTION', #{path}, m.owner_symbol_id, m.method_id , CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), m.file_id, m.line_start FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = #{methodId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = m.revision_id AND e.endpoint_type = 'TRANSACTION' AND e.method_id = m.method_id)

INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, to_external , confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{fromKind}, #{fromId}, #{relationType}, #{toKind}, #{toId}, #{toExternal} , #{confidence}, #{resolutionStatus}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_symbol s SET layer = #{layer}, layer_confidence = 'HIGH' WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = s.revision_id AND a.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND a.target_id = s.symbol_id AND a.annotation_name IN #{name})

UPDATE analysis_symbol s SET layer = #{layer}, layer_confidence = 'MEDIUM' WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol t ON t.revision_id = r.revision_id AND t.symbol_id = r.to_id WHERE r.revision_id = s.revision_id AND r.from_id = s.symbol_id AND r.relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS') AND COALESCE(r.to_external, t.fqn) = #{superType})

UPDATE analysis_symbol s SET layer = #{layer}, layer_confidence = 'LOW' WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer IS NULL AND s.kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' AND s.properties_json->>'synthetic' IS NULL AND s.simple_name ~ #{pattern}
mapper.select: SELECT endpoint_type AS "endpointType", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_endpoint WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY endpoint_type ORDER BY endpoint_type

SELECT COALESCE(layer, '(없음)') AS "layer" , COALESCE(layer_confidence, '') AS "confidence" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' GROUP BY layer, layer_confidence ORDER BY layer, layer_confidence
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_endpoint e

SELECT e.endpoint_id AS "endpointId" , e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , e.http_method AS "httpMethod" , e.path AS "path" , s.fqn AS "type" , s.layer AS "layer" , e.method_id AS "methodId" , m.signature AS "signature" , e.properties_json::text AS "properties" , f.path AS "file" , e.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_endpoint e JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = e.file_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = e.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = e.symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id
ORDER BY e.endpoint_type, e.path, s.fqn, e.endpoint_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE a.annotation_name WHEN 'Schema' THEN COALESCE(a.attributes_json->>'description', a.attributes_json->>'title') ELSE a.attributes_json->>'value' END AS text FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = f.revision_id AND a.target_kind = 'FIELD' AND a.target_id = f.field_id AND a.annotation_name IN ('ApiModelProperty', 'Schema', 'Comment') ORDER BY a.annotation_id LIMIT 1 ) an ON TRUE
upper(CASE WHEN f.name ~ '[a-z0-9][A-Z]' THEN regexp_replace(f.name, '([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', '\1_\2', 'g') ELSE f.name END)
mapper.select:
WITH cols AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.col FROM analysis_relation t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.properties_json->'columns') = 'array' THEN t.properties_json->'columns' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS c(col) WHERE t.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE') UNION SELECT r.properties_json->>'column' FROM analysis_resource r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.resource_type = 'DDL_COLUMN' ) SELECT f.field_id AS "fieldId", f.name AS "fieldName", s.fqn AS "ownerFqn" , cols.col AS "column", an.text AS "description" , f.file_id AS "fileId", fl.path AS "path", fl.encoding AS "encoding", f.line_start AS "lineStart", f.line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_field f JOIN cols ON cols.col = JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = f.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = f.owner_symbol_id JOIN analysis_file fl ON fl.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT f.is_static AND NOT f.is_synthetic ORDER BY f.file_id, f.line_start

SELECT s.symbol_id AS "symbolId", s.fqn AS "fqn" , COALESCE(t.attributes_json->>'name', t.attributes_json->>'value') AS "table" , (SELECT CASE d.annotation_name WHEN 'Schema' THEN COALESCE(d.attributes_json->>'description', d.attributes_json->>'title') WHEN 'ApiModel' THEN COALESCE(d.attributes_json->>'description', d.attributes_json->>'value') ELSE d.attributes_json->>'value' END FROM analysis_annotation d WHERE d.revision_id = t.revision_id AND d.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND d.target_id = s.symbol_id AND d.annotation_name IN ('ApiModel', 'Schema', 'Comment') ORDER BY d.annotation_id LIMIT 1) AS "description" , s.file_id AS "fileId", fl.path AS "path", fl.encoding AS "encoding", s.line_start AS "lineStart", s.line_start AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_annotation t JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = t.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = t.target_id JOIN analysis_file fl ON fl.file_id = s.file_id WHERE t.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND t.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND t.annotation_name = 'Table' ORDER BY s.file_id, s.line_start

SELECT f.field_id AS "fieldId", f.name AS "fieldName", s.fqn AS "ownerFqn" , COALESCE(t.attributes_json->>'name', t.attributes_json->>'value') AS "table" , (SELECT c.attributes_json->>'name' FROM analysis_annotation c WHERE c.revision_id = f.revision_id AND c.target_kind = 'FIELD' AND c.target_id = f.field_id AND c.annotation_name IN ('Column', 'JoinColumn') ORDER BY c.annotation_id LIMIT 1) AS "columnName" , AS "column" , an.text AS "description" , f.file_id AS "fileId", fl.path AS "path", fl.encoding AS "encoding", f.line_start AS "lineStart", f.line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_annotation t JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = t.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = t.target_id JOIN analysis_field f ON f.revision_id = t.revision_id AND f.owner_symbol_id = s.symbol_id JOIN analysis_file fl ON fl.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE t.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND t.target_kind = 'TYPE' AND t.annotation_name = 'Table' AND NOT f.is_static AND NOT f.is_synthetic AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis_annotation x WHERE x.revision_id = f.revision_id AND x.target_kind = 'FIELD' AND x.target_id = f.field_id AND x.annotation_name = 'Transient') ORDER BY f.file_id, f.line_start
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_resource (revision_id, resource_type, name, location, value, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{resourceType}, #{name}, NULL, #{value}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT m.method_id AS "methodId", m.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.file_id = #{fileId} AND NOT m.is_synthetic AND m.line_start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.line_start, m.method_id
